ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RM-5,
Residential Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 12-E in the
area bound by:

East 50'" Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Michigan Avenue; a line 200
feet south of and parallel to East 50'" Street; and South Michigan Avenue,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

thi Navel

Pat Dowell
Alderman, 3 Ward

Common Address:
5001 S. Michigan Avenue
